description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginResult" name="Login result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderReady" name="Order ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Address" name="Shipping and billing address"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginCredentials" sourceRef="Task_SendCredentials" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_ReceiveLoginResult" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="Event_ReceiveLoginResult" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderReady" sourceRef="Task_SendOrderReady" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderReady" messageRef="Message_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Start_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmationToEShop" sourceRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveBankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmationToCustomer" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Address" sourceRef="Task_SendAddress" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddress" messageRef="Message_Address"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log into the E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCredentials" name="Send login credentials" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveLoginResult" name="Receive login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginResult" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" name="Was login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckProducts" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Were all products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrderReady" name="Submit completed product selection" messageRef="Message_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerSplit" name="Complete payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" name="Is the shipping address different from the billing address?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" name="Continue with address"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAddress" name="Send shipping and billing address" messageRef="Message_Address"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerJoin" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginStopped" name="Shopping experience stopped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_SendCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendCredentials" targetRef="Event_ReceiveLoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveLoginResult" targetRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccess" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">login successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailure" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="End_LoginStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_CheckProducts" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductsSelected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SendOrderReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">all products selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_SendOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_1" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_3" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Event_ReceivePaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_4" sourceRef="Event_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_1" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDifferent" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipping address differs from billing address</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingEntered" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" targetRef="Task_SendAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_4" sourceRef="Task_SendAddress" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login credentials received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsValid" name="Are credentials valid?" default="Flow_CredentialsInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send successful login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginFailure" name="Send unsuccessful login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrderReady" name="Receive completed product selection" messageRef="Message_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrderAfterSelection" name="Finish order after product selection"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EShopSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentData" name="Receive payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveBankConfirmation" name="Receive bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EShopPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddress" name="Receive shipping and billing address" messageRef="Message_Address"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EShopJoin" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InvalidCredentials" name="Login rejected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_1" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsValid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentials are valid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsInvalid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="Task_SendLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_3" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrderReady" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderAfterSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_5" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderAfterSelection" targetRef="Gateway_EShopSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Payment_1" sourceRef="Gateway_EShopSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Payment_2" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Payment_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Payment_4" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Event_ReceiveBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Payment_5" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveBankConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Payment_6" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_EShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Shipment_1" sourceRef="Gateway_EShopSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Shipment_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_Shipment_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddress" targetRef="Gateway_EShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_6" sourceRef="Gateway_EShopJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_7" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="End_InvalidCredentials"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Bank payment confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendBankConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Bank" name="Payment confirmation sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation" targetRef="End_Bank"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
